changelog:
Version 7.8.76

Improvements

  • The main image of each page is now always preloaded once for phones and once for larger screens, at the site's own breakpoint, with no duplicates.
  • Entrance animations now play exactly as the site's own design intends.

Fixes

  • Fixed a background image that could disappear after the page finished loading on desktop when the section used a background motion effect.
  • Fixed slider pagination dots that could lose their styling.
